Convert series names between udaman and R forms

rename_udaman.Rd

Convert series names between udaman and R forms

Usage

rename_udaman(ser_in, freq = NULL, to = c("udaman", "full", "compact"))

Arguments

ser_in

series names in any of the forms MNEMONIC_LOC, MNEMONIC__LOC_F, MNEMONIC_AT_LOC_F or MNEMONIC@LOC.F. One string may hold several names separated by commas, semicolons or spaces.

freq

what follows the location, replacing any frequency in the names: a frequency ("D", "W", "M", "Q", "S", "A"), another suffix such as "SOLA" for an AREMOS solution bank, or "" for none (UR@US). NULL (default) keeps the frequency in the names. Not used when to is "compact", which has no frequency.

to

the form of the output: "udaman" (default, E_NF@HI.M), "full" (E_NF_AT_HI_M, the R form that keeps the frequency) or "compact" (E_NF_HI, no frequency). "full" and "compact" are the forms of get_series(rename = ).

Value

series names in the form to

Details

In MNEMONIC_AT_LOC and MNEMONIC@LOC the location is the part after _AT_ or @, so any location works (CAN, CA, ...). In MNEMONIC_LOC and MNEMONIC__LOC the location must be one of HI, HON, HAW, MAU, KAU, MAUI, MOL, LAN, NBI, US and JP, just before the frequency or the end of the name. HI5, HI3, HIALL and CNTY expand to the matching sets of counties, so the output can be longer than the input. A name whose location cannot be read stops with an error naming it, and so does a name with no frequency when to is "udaman" and freq is NULL. The R forms replace the % of udaman names with P (OCUP% becomes OCUPP).

Examples

rename_udaman(c("E_NF_HI", "ECT_HI", "E_TU_HAW"), freq = "M")
#> [1] "E_NF@HI.M"  "ECT@HI.M"   "E_TU@HAW.M"
rename_udaman(c("E_NF__HI_M", "ECT__HI_M", "VAP__HAW_W"))
#> [1] "E_NF@HI.M" "ECT@HI.M"  "VAP@HAW.W"
rename_udaman(c("E_NF_AT_HI_M", "ECT_AT_HI_M", "VAP_AT_HAW_W"))
#> [1] "E_NF@HI.M" "ECT@HI.M"  "VAP@HAW.W"
rename_udaman(c("E_NF@HI.M", "ECT@HI.M", "VAP@HAW.W"))
#> [1] "E_NF@HI.M" "ECT@HI.M"  "VAP@HAW.W"
rename_udaman(c("SH_US@HI.M", "SH_JP__HON_M"))
#> [1] "SH_US@HI.M"  "SH_JP@HON.M"
rename_udaman(c("EAF_AT_HAW", "GDP_R_AT_CAN"), freq = "SOLA")
#> [1] "EAF@HAW.SOLA"   "GDP_R@CAN.SOLA"
rename_udaman(c("UR_AT_US", "GDP_R_AT_US"), freq = "")
#> [1] "UR@US"    "GDP_R@US"
rename_udaman(c("E_NF_HI5", "ECT__HIALL", "E_TU@CNTY"), freq = "M")
#>  [1] "E_NF@HI.M"  "E_NF@HON.M" "E_NF@HAW.M" "E_NF@MAU.M" "E_NF@KAU.M"
#>  [6] "ECT@HI.M"   "ECT@HON.M"  "ECT@HAW.M"  "ECT@MAU.M"  "ECT@KAU.M" 
#> [11] "ECT@MAUI.M" "ECT@MOL.M"  "ECT@LAN.M"  "E_TU@HON.M" "E_TU@HAW.M"
#> [16] "E_TU@MAU.M" "E_TU@KAU.M"
rename_udaman(c("E_NF_HI5 , ECT__HIALL  E_TU@CNTY", "VAP_HAW ; ECT_HON"), freq = "M")
#>  [1] "E_NF@HI.M"  "E_NF@HON.M" "E_NF@HAW.M" "E_NF@MAU.M" "E_NF@KAU.M"
#>  [6] "ECT@HI.M"   "ECT@HON.M"  "ECT@HAW.M"  "ECT@MAU.M"  "ECT@KAU.M" 
#> [11] "ECT@MAUI.M" "ECT@MOL.M"  "ECT@LAN.M"  "E_TU@HON.M" "E_TU@HAW.M"
#> [16] "E_TU@MAU.M" "E_TU@KAU.M" "VAP@HAW.M"  "ECT@HON.M" 
# from udaman names to the R forms
rename_udaman(c("E_NF@HI.M", "OCUP%@HAW.M"), to = "full")
#> [1] "E_NF_AT_HI_M"   "OCUPP_AT_HAW_M"
rename_udaman(c("E_NF@HI.M", "OCUP%@HAW.M"), to = "compact")
#> [1] "E_NF_HI"   "OCUPP_HAW"
rename_udaman("E_NF_HI", freq = "Q", to = "full")
#> [1] "E_NF_AT_HI_Q"
quarterly_data_example |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~ rename_udaman(., freq = "Q"), .cols = -1) |>
  names() |>
  head()
#> [1] "time"      "E_NF@HI.Q" "ECT@HI.Q"  "EMN@HI.Q"  "EWT@HI.Q"  "ERT@HI.Q" 
quarterly_data_example |>
  tsbox::ts_long() |>
  dplyr::mutate(id = rename_udaman(id, freq = "Q")) |>
  tsbox::ts_xts() |>
  colnames() |>
  head()
#> [1] "E_NF@HI.Q"    "ECT@HI.Q"     "EMN@HI.Q"     "EWT@HI.Q"     "ERT@HI.Q"    
#> [6] "E_TRADE@HI.Q"
